title: Tiltboard weekly check-in: UI + Rollouts + Analytics
body:
Tiltboard weekly check-in — compact notes and action items
Date: 2027-06-07
Attendees: Maya, Jordan, Ethan, Sofia, Priya, Tom (ops) — dropped in for analytics segment
Purpose: quick alignment on UI experiments, canary rollout readiness, and analytics pipeline health. Keep this lightweight; triage items only.

1) Quick wins / updates (last 7 days)
- UI: polished the new panel collapse affordance; animation stutter reduced by switching to composited transforms (PR 1287). UX review + signoff pending — Jordan to schedule 15m with design.
- Rollouts: feature-flag gating for panel-experiments wired into backend; canary route configured to 5% for internal accounts. Canary trigger works end-to-end in staging.
- Analytics: initial telemetry for 'panel_open' and 'panel_close' landed; event schemas agreed. Ingest latency in pipeline reduced from ~18s -> ~6s after batching tweak.

2) UI experiments — open questions
- Persisted panel state across sessions: discussion in design flagged edge-case where workspace restores could overwrite user pin. Decision: store last-action timestamp and apply only if more recent than server-side workspace snapshot. Maya to write a short doc (by EOD 2027-06-09).
- Accessibility audit: automated axe-run shows color contrast issues on new warning chips. Low priority but schedule in next sprint — Sofia to add to backlog ticket.

3) Rollout readiness and safety checks
- Canary target: internal 5% for today, ramp plan to 25% over 48hrs if errors < 0.3% and latency delta < 10%
- Fallback policy: immediate rollback to stable variant plus notification to #console-ops. Confirmed with SRE runbook.
- Load test notes: synthetic traffic at 2x produced steady-state memory pressure in one Dedicated node; observed OOMs on variant-quantized builds. Action: Ethan to add memory headroom guard, target patch by 2027-06-09.

4) Analytics pipeline deep-dive (Tom)
- Problem: sampling skew for anonymous users — sessions from APAC were underrepresented due to shard misconfig in streaming job. Root cause: geo-tagging step ran after sampling.
- Fix: reorder transform so geo-tagging happens before sampler; deploy window scheduled for 2027-06-10 02:00 UTC with quick backout.
- Metrics to watch post-fix: sample distribution by region, event ingestion lag, and SU (sampled users) variance. Priya to add dashboard panels with 1h/6h/24h resolution.

5) Blockers
- PR 1293 (panel keyboard navigation) blocked by flaky integration test related to focus trap — suspect race in mounting. Jordan to reproduce locally and open a flake tracking ticket if needed.
- Dedicated variant OOM on heavy-batch paths (see above) blocks rolling to 10% for canary. Workaround: restrict batching window for that variant until memory fix.

6) Ops rehearsals and runbook items
- Went through a 10min rehearse: simulated canary failure (injected 5xx) -> automated fallback triggered, Slack alert posted, on-call SRE engaged. Notes: alert message could be clearer about which variant rolled back. Action: Maya to update alert template.
- Postmortem template reminder: when an unexpected fallback occurs, include timeline of events, waveform of error rate, and exact toggle state.

7) Action items (owner — due)
- Jordan: schedule 15m UX signoff for collapse affordance; attach test cases (2027-06-09)
- Ethan: implement memory headroom guard + unit test for batching module (2027-06-09)
- Priya: add analytics panels for sample distribution + ingestion lag, create alert if imbalance > 15% for any region (2027-06-10)
- Maya: draft persisted-state decision doc and update canary alert template (2027-06-09)
- Sofia: add accessibility item to sprint backlog + copy of axe report (2027-06-11)

8) Parking lot / topics for next tiltboard
- Telemetry cost estimate for 1 year of retention at 30% sampling vs 10% sampling (finance ask)
- Evaluate using KV prefix cache stats as a signal for routing (possible improvement for latency SLOs)
- Longer discussion: UX for private deployments where telemetry is opt-in — invite product security next time.

Notes / loose links
- Quick references: linear/RDWD-4923 (canary orchestration), github/console-ui#1287 (panel collapse PR), confluence/tiltboard-runbook (runbook draft)
- Tone: keep canaries small and instrumented; prefer short ramp windows + explicit rollback conditions.

End of capture. Next check-in: 2027-06-14 (same slot)
